verdict_reason: The hand-union is exactly base + 5 branch keys + 1 main key; all 12 pre-existing values are byte-identical to base in both locales; no key was added by both sides and no value conflicts; the five branch values are byte-identical to the file the round-4 ur audit passed; main's new value is idiomatic and in the same voice; no placeholder, plural, bidi or punctuation regression. One MINOR (volume calque) is pre-existing and non-gating under the blocker/major gate.

findings.problem: Literal calque: حجم is volume in the bulk/size sense, not the loudness of an audio slider. The possessive آواز کا حجم reads as 'the bulk of the sound'; the locale's own word for audio is آواز, and its one existing والیوم is the disk-volume sense (ui.chat.directory.folder.volumes = والیومز), so borrowing that would collide senses.
findings.suggested: آواز (terse slider name) or آواز کی سطح
findings.severity_reasoning: Comprehensible and not unsafe; no glossary row fixes the term, so this is idiom, not a term violation. Not raised to MAJOR: it misleads nobody about what the control does.
findings.first_filed: r3 (ur review, U-03), reconfirmed r4 (d2cc21c7d250-r4-ur) and independently re-derived here before reading either receipt
findings.union_impact: none — the value is byte-identical to base and to the r4-audited branch file; the hand-union neither introduced nor altered it

considered_and_not_filed.why_not_filed: I first read مقام as a rank/flank sense for a seek bar, but the locale renders 'position/location' with مقام throughout (45 occurrences, including Location = مقام and 'to position {n}' = {n} مقام پر), while پوزیشن appears nowhere. Consistent with the locale's own choice, so no finding would be honest here.
considered_and_not_filed.note: Recorded because an auditor who silently drops a doubt is indistinguishable from one who never had it.

considered_and_not_filed.why_not_filed: رفتار is the locale's established rendering for 'rate' in performance strings (ڈیکوڈ کی رفتار, تخلیق کی رفتار); consistent.
Respectful imperative, already the locale's form for 'Open' (کھولیں appears in the error_block strings).
